decision_text: Evaluation 1 (g0-b3) is complete: four of four inputs measured, every run rc 0 inside the 1500 s abort. The campaign-stop clause is not triggered (250/310 counts 8/10 reproduce B3 exactly). The registered rejection clause is met: sweep-43 late-return rows miss by +1.40 to +1.72 mV while onset rows hold, so every Stage G arm is judged on the change of its sweep-43 late-return rows relative to g0-b3 (+1.4 to +1.7 mV), not on an absolute 1 mV pass. The 200 pA count prediction missed (4 spikes against the exact repeat band of 1); it is carried into Stage G as a scored row (G1 predicts 1, G2 predicts 0-1). Axon-first initiation held at 50/53/56. Stage G opens as registered (g1-ih-half and g2-leak-150 at sweeps 43/50/53/56) with the measured cost below; this decision does not launch it, and each Stage G launch still needs per-job approval under the run-duration rule.

stage_g_cost_estimate.statement: One evaluation at four inputs measured 3274 s wall (54.6 min) run serially, one container at a time (50/53/56 on an unshared host). Two Stage G arms run concurrently per the manifest (max_concurrent 2); the cost of two containers side by side on this host is not measured, and the 1500 s abort held every serial run with 655-720 s to spare.

recommendation: Stage G may be approved per job on the measured 3274 s per evaluation; run the two arms one container at a time unless a concurrent-pair duration is measured first. Score both arms on the change of the sweep-43 late-return rows and on the 200 pA count (base 4).
gain_reading: Human counts 1/5/10/13 at 200/250/310/350 pA; model 4/8/10/12. The model matches the human slope between 200 and 250 pA (0.080 vs 0.080 spikes/pA) but sits three spikes above the donor at both inputs, then flattens between 250 and 310 pA (0.033 vs 0.083) to meet the pinned 310 pA point, and stays flat above it (0.050 vs 0.075). The error is an excess of firing at low drive (200-250 pA) that the 310 pA pin absorbs, not a uniformly compressed slope; the first spike at 200 pA comes 78 ms early and is followed by three spikes the donor never fires.
